name: Boxing Stance
alt: Boxer demonstrating a basic boxing stance
description: Stand with your feet comfortably apart, keep your knees slightly bent, and maintain a balanced position.

name: Jab
description: The jab is a quick straight punch thrown with the lead hand.

name: Cross
description: The cross is a straight punch thrown with the rear hand while rotating the body.

name: Lead Hook
description: The lead hook is a short circular punch that uses rotation from the hips and shoulders.

name: Rear Hook
description: The rear hook is a circular punch performed with the rear hand while rotating through the body.

name: Uppercut
description: The uppercut is an upward punch that begins close to the body and travels upward.

name: Forward Footwork
description: Practice moving forward while maintaining your stance and keeping your balance.

name: Backward Footwork
description: Practice stepping backward while maintaining your stance and keeping your hands up.

name: Side-to-Side Footwork
description: Move from side to side while maintaining your boxing stance and balance.

name: Shadow Boxing
description: Practice punches, movement, and defensive techniques without a training partner or bag.

name: Slip
description: Practice moving your head slightly to the side while maintaining your stance and balance.

name: Jump Rope
alt: Boxer exercising with a jump rope
description: Use a jump rope to improve coordination, rhythm, footwork, and cardiovascular fitness.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: Perform controlled squats to strengthen the legs and improve lower-body stability for boxing.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: Use controlled mountain climbers to challenge your core and cardiovascular endurance.

name: Defensive Guard
description: Practice keeping your hands in a protective position while maintaining balance and awareness.
